target: 100% completion on the chosen PS3 HD remaster route, spoiler-free

areas.name: Route and Save Setup
areas.location_cue: The PS3 collection menu, difficulty selector, manual-save slots, and Treasures menu.
areas.note: Chosen route: PS3 HD remaster through original hardware or RPCS3; no secondary platform-exclusive content.

levels.1: Confirm the version before creating the completion file.
levels.2: Play the first game through God of War Collection or God of War Saga on PS3 or RPCS3.
levels.3: Launch the PS3 HD remaster and select the first game from the collection menu. Keep it separate from the 2018 title with the same name; no PS2- or Vita-exclusive gameplay branch is required.

levels.1: This campaign has no chapter-select cleanup.
levels.2: Maintain several manual slots and preserve one save before leaving the rotating temple.
levels.3: Rotate through at least three slots, retain an early city save, and keep a permanent file in the rotating-ring hub before using the upward exit. A missed chest can require a new campaign once later replacement opportunities are exhausted.

levels.1: A full clear opens the post-game completion menus.
levels.2: Finish one campaign on any available difficulty and retain its clear data.
levels.3: Complete the campaign through its final results, accept the clear-data save, and return to the main menu. Confirm that the hardest difficulty, the ten-part challenge set, and the first group of Treasures entries are now available.

levels.1: One bonus entry has its own difficulty condition.
levels.2: Start a clean Spartan-difficulty campaign and finish it.
levels.3: Choose Spartan when beginning a new file, keep that setting unchanged, and complete the full campaign. Return to Treasures afterward and confirm the dedicated Spartan-clear entry has opened.

levels.1: The hardest setting appears only after a first clear.
levels.2: Finish a second full campaign on the unlocked God difficulty.
levels.3: After creating clear data, start God difficulty without selecting a costume, because costumes are disabled there. Finish the campaign and save again; this opens the final difficulty-gated Treasure entries.

levels.1: A missed upgrade may reappear later rather than vanish immediately.
levels.2: Track the first 18 eyes, 18 feathers, and both keys while also recording each area's chest total.
levels.3: Unlit chests can substitute a missed eye, feather, or key at later opportunities. Once a category is complete, later substitutes yield red orbs instead; after every weapon and power is maximized, red chests can change to magic recovery. Use the numbered rare-item route in this pack for a stable ledger.

levels.1: Treat every branch, breakable wall, and camera-hidden ledge as part of the route.
levels.2: Use the per-area chest-sweep records until their totals add to 330.
levels.3: Record each area's total immediately before crossing its one-way exit. The full ledger is 46 health, 26 magic, 70 colour-changing, 151 red-orb, 18 eye, 17 feather, and two key chests; the eighteenth feather comes from an optional underwater interaction on the earliest route.

save_backup.title: Create the rotating save set now
save_backup.why: There is no chapter select, and later one-way exits can make early cleanup impossible.

levels.1: Spend red orbs deliberately instead of spreading them across unfinished powers.
levels.2: Raise Starting Chained Blades to level 5.
levels.3: Open the power-up menu and purchase every remaining tier in order: 1,500 + 2,250 + 3,750 + 9,000 red orbs, for 16,500 total. Do not mark this complete until the menu shows level 5 with no further purchase prompt.

levels.1: The full upgrade ledger needs substantially more than a normal rushed route.
levels.2: Spend 65,650 red orbs across both weapons and all four magic powers.
levels.3: Complete the six individual maximum-upgrade records in this area. If normal chest and combat rewards leave a deficit, preserve a safe save and farm the repeating enemy or magic-chest opportunities before their puzzles are closed; confirm every red chest changes behaviour only after the full arsenal is maxed.

levels.1: The starting weapon's last tier changes the full-meter state.
levels.2: Purchase level 5 of the starting chained blades.
levels.3: Buy all four chained-blade upgrades for 16,500 red orbs total. Fill the Rage meter, activate it with both stick-click inputs, and confirm the final tier allows magic use without draining the magic bar during that state.

areas.name: Challenge of the Gods
areas.location_cue: The post-clear Treasures menu and its isolated combat-trial arenas.
areas.note: The ten trials run consecutively with no between-trial save; finishing all ten unlocks the costume set.

levels.1: The post-clear menu contains a continuous trial sequence.
levels.2: Finish one campaign, then open Challenge of the Gods from Treasures.
levels.3: Create clear data after any campaign finish, return to the main menu, enter Treasures, and start the challenge set. The ten trials must be completed in one continuous session because progress cannot be saved between them.

levels.1: Push enemies outward without defeating them directly.
levels.2: Knock eight enemies from the platform within 55 seconds without killing one first.
levels.3: Stay near the centre and use grabs, launches, or the ground-wave attack to send each target over an edge. Avoid long damage combos; a direct kill fails the trial, as does being pushed off.

levels.1: Separate required ground targets from the endless airborne distractions.
levels.2: Eliminate every soldier and archer before 115 seconds expire.
levels.3: Ignore the flying enemies because they do not advance the objective. Clear archers first with ranged magic, then use the area spell and fast blade combos on the remaining soldiers until the trial ends.

levels.1: Use broad attacks and keep moving around the perimeter.
levels.2: Break every pot within 21 seconds.
levels.3: Begin with a sweeping ground attack, circle the arena while using wide chained-blade strikes, and finish isolated pots with quick single hits. Restart immediately if the camera shows a missed pot behind you.

levels.1: Target only the four large enemies.
levels.2: Defeat four large targets without killing any accompanying soldier.
levels.3: Avoid area magic and wide combos. Draw one large target away, petrify or damage it with focused attacks, finish it, and repeat; restart if a soldier is caught in the final blow.

levels.1: Wait for a clean firing lane before releasing the fixed weapon.
levels.2: Use the ballista to hit every distant soldier while sparing all civilians.
levels.3: Track the moving figures on the far platform and fire only when a soldier stands clear of every civilian. There is no timer, so let unsafe alignments pass instead of risking an automatic failure.

levels.1: Momentum matters more than fighting the archers.
levels.2: Reach the centre of the final platform within 35 seconds.
levels.3: Roll through incoming arrows, jump each gap from its near edge, and do not stop to attack. Correct the camera before every leap and land in the marked centre of the last platform before time expires.

levels.1: Distance and airborne attacks reduce the chance of taking a hit.
levels.2: Defeat every enemy within 90 seconds without being struck.
levels.3: Open with ranged attacks on exposed targets, then repeatedly jump and use the airborne ground-wave move from outside melee range. Reset the instant any attack connects; one hit fails the trial.

levels.1: Fight from the air and roll whenever a gaze begins.
levels.2: Defeat every enemy without magic; there is no time limit.
levels.3: Use airborne ground-wave attacks to control the crowd, land away from large targets, and roll continuously whenever the petrification beam starts. Resume attacking only after the beam ends.

levels.1: Ignore the smaller attackers and burst down the four required targets.
levels.2: Defeat four cyclopes within 150 seconds.
levels.3: Keep the camera on a required target, use the heavy three-hit chained-blade combo, and evade smaller enemies rather than chasing them. Repeat on each new cyclops until the fourth falls.

levels.1: Fight near the middle so the rising platform cannot shed you.
levels.2: Raise the combat platform to the upper ledge while enemies keep spawning.
levels.3: Stay near centre and use rising or airborne knockback attacks to throw smaller enemies outward. Successful attacks raise the platform, while hanging from its rim lowers it; recover inward after every jump until you can step onto the top ledge.

save_backup.title: Set aside an uninterrupted challenge session
save_backup.why: Closing the mode before all ten are complete discards the current sequence.

levels.1: Most bonus-menu entries open together after the initial campaign.
levels.2: After the first clear, inspect every newly available entry in Treasures.
levels.3: Save the clear data, return to Treasures, and open all eight first-clear entries at least once: the behind-the-scenes videos, galleries, credits, removed material, and in-game movie viewer. Leave the menu only after none of those eight remains newly marked.

levels.1: One bonus entry is tied to the hard preset.
levels.2: Complete Spartan difficulty and inspect its newly opened Treasures entry.
levels.3: Finish a full Spartan campaign without lowering the difficulty, save the clear data, and return to Treasures. Open the single new Spartan-gated entry once so its unseen marker clears.

levels.1: The last two menu rewards require the unlocked hardest preset.
levels.2: Complete God difficulty and inspect both newly opened Treasures entries.
levels.3: Finish the full God-difficulty campaign, save its clear data, and return to Treasures. Open both newly available entries, the final video and first secret-message record, without revealing their narrative contents in this guide.

levels.1: A physical Easter egg adds the remaining secret entry.
levels.2: Destroy both durable statues in the final throne room before ending the campaign.
levels.3: Use a fully upgraded ground-wave attack on each statue until both break, wait for the scrambled message, and finish the campaign normally. Reload the clear data and verify the second secret record is retained.

levels.1: The complete challenge set unlocks costumes with mechanical modifiers.
levels.2: Finish all ten challenges, start a new non-God campaign, and select Chef of War.
levels.3: Complete the challenge sequence, choose New Game on Mortal, Hero, or Spartan difficulty, and select Chef of War after the difficulty prompt. Reach the first controllable scene and confirm that it increases the magic restored by blue orbs; costumes cannot be used on God difficulty.
